headline: Newsroom Brief Previews Week 4 of Senate Impeachment Proceedings
seoTitle: Brief: Senate Impeachment Week 4 Witnesses Previewed
seoDescription: An FMB News overnight brief previews former disbursing officers as expected witnesses as Senate impeachment proceedings enter a fourth week.
deck: The overnight package says prosecutors planned to shift from audit testimony to witnesses involved in disbursement and cash handling.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The August 17 FMB News overnight brief reports that the Senate impeachment proceedings were set to enter a fourth week with former disbursing officers and cash custodians expected to testify about confidential-fund transactions.

Because this story was published before the scheduled Monday session, FMB News treats the witness lineup and starting time as a pre-session report rather than as a statement that the testimony had already occurred.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The package says the expected testimony would follow earlier audit evidence and focus on disbursement vouchers, liquidation records and the physical handling of funds.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Witness testimony can shape how senator-judges assess documentary evidence, accountability and competing factual claims in an impeachment trial.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the official Senate record for which witnesses actually appear, rulings on objections and the substance of direct and cross-examination.
